Thank you all. I think I have what I need to make a decision. Let me summarize where we are and my plan:

First, on the procedure requirements Ruth raised: I'm going to treat all three safeguards as mandatory — written opt-in for any conflict-repair exercises, a neutral facilitator replacing the manager-led reflection, and exactly two follow-up check-ins after the event. The current draft will be revised to reflect all three.

Second, on Leo's concern: I'm not going to approve supervisor-employee pairings in the paired exercises as currently structured. Leo will file a formal incident summary promptly, and once I review it along with the procedure memo, I'll make a final determination on the pairing structure. But given the procedural requirements for a neutral facilitator and written opt-in, those exercises need reworking regardless.

Third, on Imani's accommodation: The afternoon sessions from 13:00 to 16:00 will be structured to be remote-accessible so Imani can participate meaningfully. I'll also ask the planning team to review the morning sessions to ensure nothing critical is scheduled in a way that would disadvantage remote participants.

I'm not approving the current draft as-is. I'll hold approval until I've reviewed the procedure memo Ruth is sending today and Leo's incident summary is on file. Once I have both, I'll finalize the revised format incorporating all three procedural safeguards, the pairing restriction, and Imani's remote accommodation. Ruth, please also make sure the procedure memo gets formally attached to the event packet going forward.

Does anyone have anything else before I finalize this approach?
